content.title: How to watch Virginia vs. Georgia women’s basketball: First Round TV channel and streaming options for March 21
content.text: The No. 7 Georgia Lady Bulldogs (22-9) and the No. 10 Virginia Cavaliers (20-11) meet on Saturday for a spot in the second round of the NCAA Tournament. The first-round matchup begins at 1:30 p.m. ET.How to watch Virginia Cavaliers vs. Georgia Lady Bulldogs Venue: Carver-Hawkeye Arena Time: 1:30 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: ESPN2 Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Virginia vs. Georgia odds Spread: Georgia -2.5 (-110), Virginia +2.5 (-110) Favorite Moneyline: Georgia -161 Underdog Moneyline: Virginia +135 Total: 131.5 Total Over Odds: -110 Total Under Odds: -110 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Georgia has a +375 scoring differential, topping opponents by 12.1 points per game. It is putting up 73.6 points per game to rank 54th in college basketball and is giving up 61.5 per contest to rank 110th in college basketball. Georgia connects on 6.7 three-pointers per game (127th in college basketball) compared to its opponents’ 5.7. It shoots 33.4% from deep while its opponents hit 29.4% from long range. Virginia has a +331 scoring differential, topping opponents by 10.7 points per game. It is putting up 74.7 points per game, 42nd in college basketball, and is giving up 64 per outing to rank 173rd in college basketball. Virginia connects on 6.3 three-pointers per game (162nd in college basketball) at a 31.5% rate (141st in college basketball), compared to the 6.4 its opponents make, shooting 33.6% from beyond the arc.
